title: JoDiffusion: Jointly Diffusing Image with Pixel-Level Annotations for Semantic Segmentation Promotion
mechanism: An annotation VAE maps masks into the image latent space and one latent diffusion model generates image and mask jointly, with a mask-optimisation step to reduce annotation noise.
adaptation: Replace text prompts with source + class-presence tokens; annotation VAE over 24 classes; 64x64 latent loses cracks, so use for other classes and inactive; recent joint baseline for the benchmark synthetic track.
min_experiment: Benchmark baseline: PF + JoDiffusion pairs vs PF. Metric mIoU_rob and per-class IoU of gridline/splice/edge_dark. Reported, no kill; drop if mIoU_rob < +0.005.
evidence: R: Pascal VOC, COCO, ADE20K gains over prior synthetic-data methods; 72.5 mIoU VOC per a web summary.

alt_notes.adaptation: Source + class-presence tokens instead of text; annotation VAE over 24 classes; use for other classes only (latent loses cracks).
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF + JoDiffusion pairs vs PF, metric mIoU_rob; benchmark baseline, reported. About 50 GPU-h.
